summary.text: Robert Britto is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 18 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Robert Britto was born in Providence, lives in Rumford, and earned a degree from Stonehill College.

His career experience includes working as a design and construction specialist at Rhode Island Housing and Mortgage Finance Corp., a retail project manager at Alex & Ani, an assistant project manager at Michael's, and a general contractor.
Britto served three terms as the Ward 1 representative on the East Providence City Council.
He took office in the State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Cynthia Mendes, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
